bagPolicy.summary: Only clear plastic or vinyl totes up to 12 × 6 × 12 inches and small nonclear clutches up to 6 × 9 inches may enter; all bags are searched.
bagPolicy.note: Policies may change or vary by event. Review the linked official guidance shortly before arrival.

parking.summary: General parking is $20 per vehicle online in advance or $25 on show day, paid by card or mobile wallet. Rockstar parking enters Gate 2, and Premier or Ultra Premier enter Gate 6 or 9.
parking.note: Policies may change or vary by event. Review the linked official guidance shortly before arrival.

rideshare.summary: The amphitheater visitor page describes parking and casino shuttles but does not publish a designated app-based rideshare pickup site.
rideshare.note: Policies may change or vary by event. Review the linked official guidance shortly before arrival.

concessions.summary: Food and beverages are sold inside; one guest may bring food in a clear one-gallon bag and one sealed water bottle up to one gallon, or an empty nonmetal refillable bottle up to one gallon.
allowed: One sealed water bottle up to one gallon
Empty nonmetal bottle up to one gallon
concessions.note: Policies may change or vary by event. Review the linked official guidance shortly before arrival.

accessibility.summary: Accessible parking needs both a state-issued disability placard or plate and a venue parking pass; spaces are limited and first come, first served.
accessibility.note: Policies may change or vary by event. Review the linked official guidance shortly before arrival.

reEntry.summary: The amphitheater visitor FAQ does not publish a general concert re-entry rule.
reEntry.note: Policies may change or vary by event. Review the linked official guidance shortly before arrival.

ticketPickup.summary: The venue visitor FAQ does not state a universal will-call pickup procedure.

gates.summary: The main gates beside the box office admit any ticket holder. Fast Lane needs an add-on; VIP has a separate entrance beside VIP parking, while casino shuttle riders use the casino gate with their wristband.
gates.note: Policies may change or vary by event. Review the linked official guidance shortly before arrival.
